buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Bid Specific Additional Terms and Conditions Features Specifications USB and Slot Total 8 USB port , out of USB: 2 USB 10 GBPS Port .1 type c port Storage Expandiblity CPU should have the expandiblity upto 2 TB HDD and 1 TB PCIe® NVMe M.2 SSD Volume and weight No More than 16 L and 5.5 Kg Power Supply 180 - 240 W with 92% efficiency or better Security and certifications. Hardware based endpoint security controller TPM 2.0, Integrated Intrusion Sen sor, Features USB and Slot Microsoft Windows 11 FCC,CE, RoHS, UL, EPEAT, Energy Star, TCO 08, ISO 9001,14001,20001,27001 for OEM Specifications Total 8 USB port , out of USB: 2 USB 10 GBPS Port .1 type c port

Bid-Specific Additional Terms and Conditions 1. Factory Pre-loaded Genuine Windows OS: o Each PC must be pre-loaded with Microsoft Windows 11 Professional (64-bit). o An OEM declaration certifying the installation of a genuine OS must be provided. o This certificate must be signed by OEM personnel with valid Power of Attorney, including the bid numb er and date. o Post supply and installation, OEM confirmation of OS genuineness with system serial numbers must be submitted. 2. Bid-Specific OEM Authorization Certificate (MAF): o Must be provided with the bid. o Ink-signed and stamped by OEM with bid number and date clearly mentioned. 3. Uniform OEM Branding: o CPU, Monitor, Wired Keyboard, and Mouse must be from the same OEM. o All components should bear the same OEM logo 4. Comprehensive Warranty: o PCs must carry a 5-year comprehensive on-site warranty from date of installation and commissioning. o Bidder should submit declaration of 5-year onsite warranty on OEM letter head with sign, seal, bid num ber and date clearly mentioned 5. Malicious Code Certificate: o OEM must provide a certificate stating the absence of malicious code. o Should be on OEM letterhead, with bid number, date, signature, and seal. 6. Product Compliance Sheet: o Must be submitted on OEM letterhead and it should include bid number, date, sign, and seal. 7. Product Data Sheets: o Detailed data sheets of offered products must be uploaded with bid. o Technical parameters must match the offered configuration. Any mismatch may result in bid rejection. 8. OEM Operations in India: o OEM must have been operational in India for at least 15 years. o Documentary proof must be submitted. 9. Service Escalation Matrix: o Must be submitted on OEM letterhead with bid number, date, sign, and seal. 10. Compliance Check Statement: o Required on OEM letterhead with bid number, date, sign, and seal. 11. Bidder’s Local Service Center in Jharkhand Region: o Bidder must have a service center in the MMR region. o Proof like electricity bill, municipal tax receipt, etc., must be provided. 12. OEM Authorized Service Center in Consignee District:

o Documentary evidence must be submitted; otherwise, bid will be rejected. 13. Bidder Non-Blacklisting Declaration: o Must be submitted on OEM letterhead with signature and seal. 14. OEM Market Standing: o OEM must be listed among the top three companies in IDC Report (India Overall PC Market) for the last three consecutive quarters based on Market Share, Year-over-Year Growth 15. OEM Turnover: o OEM’s turnover should be more than ₹10,000 Crore for FY 2023-24. o Proof must be submitted. 16. Bidder Turnover: o Bidder should have a minimum turnover of.3Crore for FY 2023-24. o Supporting documents to be provided. 17. Mandatory Document Submission: o Bidder’s offer is liable to be rejected if any required certificates/documents from the bid, ATC, or corrig endum are missing. .
